## Sprint 42 retro recap
Great work everyone. A few highlights:
**What went well** - Shipped the NATS relay ahead of schedule - @alice squashed the intermittent reconnect bug (nice catch) - New dashboards in Grafana are actually useful
**What to improve** 1. Flaky Playwright tests need triage, see [the board](https://project.example/board) 2. Too many threads stalled waiting on review
**Action items** - Rotate review buddies weekly - Add a `test:flake` label and a budget for fixes
Full notes are pinned in ~engineering-updates.
